cuts.placeText: a self-service car wash — open wash bays with foam brushes, a coiled high-pressure hose, wet tiled floor and a vacuum post
cuts.scene: she is a new attendant kneeling to scrub a wheel with a big sponge, soap everywhere
cuts.outfit: a car wash attendant look fitted to her body — a cropped waterproof jacket tied under the chest over short denim shorts and rubber boots, bare midriff and legs, a plain blue cap
